address: 7 place de la Gare, Guer, 56380, France
bio: Garden-fresh tomato salad and courgette cream, local fish of the day, grilled meat and vegetables from local growers, followed by a vanilla millefeuille pastry with salted butter caramel: taste the market-fresh, country cuisine, without killer prices, of a star chef in this bistro, next-door to his star establishment....
